templates.heading: New document
templates.subheading: Start from a template, or from a blank page
templates.generateBody: Point AI at a repository and let it draft the document
templates.customiseTitle: Save an editable copy to this workspace
templates.retireTitle: Retire — stops offering it, keeps the row

emptyState.prompt: Start writing, or pick a template:
emptyState.failed: That template could not be loaded. Your document is untouched.

editor.markdownWarning: In Markdown, the {count, plural, one {# commented passage appears} other {# commented passages appear}} as raw HTML. Editing or deleting that markup unpins the thread from the text — the comment itself is kept either way, with the passage it was written about.

comments.empty: Select text and use the comment button to start a thread here.

provenance.behindOne: The code behind this page has changed since it was written.
provenance.behindMany: {count} of the linked paths have changed since this page was written.
provenance.willPropose: An update will be proposed for review.
provenance.syncModeProposeHint: Queue an update for review. The safe default.
provenance.syncModeAutoHint: Apply updates without asking. A full rewrite still asks, so hand-written prose is never overwritten unseen.
provenance.syncModeOffHint: Stop watching this path, including the behind-the-code badge.
provenance.syncModeFailed: Could not change the sync setting

diff.noWordingChanged: No wording changed — the update only touched formatting.
diff.unchangedBlocks: {count, plural, one {# unchanged block} other {# unchanged blocks}}
diff.tooLarge: This document is too long to diff here — use the section summary, or open the document to compare.

review.heading: {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}} waiting for review
review.emptyBody: When code changes under a document, the update it needs will show up here for review.
review.approved: Approved {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}}
review.staleOne: One of these was written against an older version of its page.
review.staleMany: {count} of these were written against older versions of their pages.
review.staleHint: Open them individually to see what would be overwritten.

sources.code_change_syncBlurb: Source these pages describe has moved on since they were written.
sources.regenerateBlurb: Someone asked for these to be rewritten from the source.
sources.suggest_improvementsBlurb: Edits proposed against the prose itself, not the code.

improvements.heading: Improve this document
improvements.intro: An AI reads the page and reports what is unclear, incomplete or missing. This costs one model call.
improvements.missingSections: Sections it expected and did not find
improvements.appliesAsProposal: Applying queues a rewrite for review. Your document is not changed until somebody approves it.

mergedChanges.heading: Recently merged
mergedChanges.subheading: Changes that landed. The best time to write about one is now, while somebody still has it in their head.
mergedChanges.noDocsForRepositoryHint: No document in this workspace is linked to anything in this repository.
mergedChanges.pagesAffected: {count, plural, one {1 page affected} other {# pages affected}}

scope.heading: Document every module in {repository}
scope.willWrite: Writes {count} documents — one per module, under a parent page. Each is one model call, run one at a time.
scope.parentFailed: Could not create the parent page

impact.coverage: {matched} of {total} changed files are described by a page here
impact.notCheckedTitle: This pull request has not been checked
impact.notCheckedNoDocs: No page in this workspace is linked to anything in this repository.
impact.notCheckedOld: It landed before documentation impact was tracked.
impact.emptyBody: No page in this workspace is linked to any file this pull request touched. Nobody was notified.
impact.statusEdited: Edited since this pull request opened
impact.askUpdateImageWarning: A generated update rewrites the prose from the source and will not carry the {count, plural, one {screenshot} other {# screenshots}} in this page. Check the diff before approving.
impact.noUpdateNeededHint: For this pull request only. The page keeps its own out-of-date badge.
impact.dismissFailed: Could not save that. Try again.
impact.updateRequested: An update was drafted and is waiting for review.
impact.prCommentBlocked: The comment on this pull request was not posted: the Aexy GitHub App needs “Pull requests: write”.

guidance.screenshots: {count, plural, one {One screenshot} other {# screenshots}} in this page, under {headings}
guidance.screenshotsNoHeading: {count, plural, one {One screenshot} other {# screenshots}} in this page
guidance.route: Your change touched the {routes} screen — that is what they show
guidance.apiSurface: The request or response shape may have moved: {paths}
guidance.setup: The setup steps in this page may no longer match: {paths}

impact.errorBody: The documentation impact for this pull request could not be fetched.

docx.conflict: Someone else saved this document while you had it open. Reload to get their version — your unsaved changes here will be lost.
docx.reviewingHint: The changes are marked up in the document. Accept or reject each one, save, then choose Done reviewing.
docx.someOpsSkipped: {count} change(s) couldn't be marked up and are not in this redline:
docx.partiallyReviewable: Some of these changes can't be shown as tracked changes yet.
docx.staleWarning: This document changed after the proposal was written. Some changes will refuse to apply; others may land in the wrong place.
docx.railTitle: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} in this proposal
docx.intakeHint: Reads the document and proposes work items. Nothing is created until you say so.
docx.intakeModelCost: Reading with the AI makes a model call. Comments and markers are free.
docx.intakeNoModelCost: No model call — this reads only what is already in the document.
docx.intakeReadFailed: Could not read the document for work items
docx.intakeNothingFound: Nothing to create from this document. That is a normal answer for a document with no work in it.
docx.intakeFound: {count, plural, one {# proposed} other {# proposed}} · {kept} selected
docx.intakeNeedsSprint: Pick a sprint — a task has to live in one.
docx.intakeNeedsForm: Pick a form — a ticket's fields and SLA come from it.
docx.intakeCreated: Created {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}}
docx.intakeNoSprints: No sprint is open to new work. Start or plan one on the sprint board, or choose another type.
docx.intakeNoForms: This workspace has no ticket forms yet. Create one in Tickets, or choose another type.
docx.intakeNeedsPersona: Say who these stories are for — a story with a placeholder persona tells a team nothing. Ones the document already wrote as "As a …, I want …" keep their own.

community.hint: Opens one public thread for this document. Write an opening message — the document itself is not copied into the forum, because it will be edited and a stale copy on a public page is worse than none.
community.introPlaceholder: What would you like people to discuss?
community.openedNotLive: Thread created — the community isn't switched on yet, so nobody outside can see it
community.failed: Could not open the discussion thread

import.title: Import a wiki
import.subtitle: Bring a Notion or Confluence export in as pages.
import.chooseFileHint: A .zip exported from Notion or Confluence. Up to 500 MB — a whole Confluence instance should be split by space first.
import.destinationHint: Importing needs admin on the space you choose.
import.runningHint: This keeps going if you close the dialog — the pages appear in the sidebar as they arrive.
import.partialHint: The pages below could not be converted. Everything else imported.
import.failedHint: Nothing further will import until this is resumed. Resuming continues where it stopped rather than starting again.
import.errorTooLarge: That archive is larger than 500 MB. Export one space at a time.
import.errorForbidden: You need admin on the destination space to import into it.
import.errorGeneric: The import could not be started.
